security_findings.finding: Microsoft Agent Framework PyPI releases 1.26.1 and 1.26.2 (Nov 2026) were HIJACKED: a .pth hook executed at Python start exfiltrating environment variables and credential files; ~192k weekly downloads affected. The github.com/microsoft/agent-framework repository went offline 2026-11-18 and remained offline at research time.
security_findings.source: OX Security incident writeup; PyPI release history; GitHub repo state 2026-11-27
security_findings.mission_consequence: Arm B8 (Microsoft Agent Framework) may only be installed from the last clean release 1.26.0, inside an isolated venv with no secrets in the environment, and with hash verification from the clean release; if the project's security posture requires a trustworthy upstream, B8 stays BLOCKED with this record. Never install 1.26.1/1.26.2. This finding also justifies hash-pinning every SDK install in this mission.

security_findings.finding: LiteLLM 1.82.7/1.82.8 supply-chain advisory (Mar 2026) noted by ADK docs; affects the LiteLLM connector path of Google ADK if used.
security_findings.mission_consequence: ADK arm connects via the native OpenAILlm connector (google.adk.integrations.openai), not LiteLLM; LiteLLM path excluded unless separately qualified.

responses_api_trap: OpenAI Agents SDK, Pydantic AI, and MS Agent Framework can all default to the OpenAI Responses API; llama.cpp b12359 implements Chat Completions. Every adapter must explicitly force Chat Completions mode; recorded as an adapter conformance test requirement.

llama.cpp discussion #27737: native tool-call JSON rejection in some builds - F08/F09 layer must catch
llama-server requires --jinja + a tool-capable chat template for native tool calls (MiniCPM5 template verified in P1)

reconciliation_with_repository.antigravity: Agent research said no OpenAI-compatible endpoint; repository evidence disproves for 0.1.24 (LocalOpenAIAgentConfig exists in the installed package and passed the G7 smoke). Passport records SDK-native local support with the repo evidence as source.

version_freeze_policy: Every SDK install is hash-pinned (pip --require-hashes or lock export) into an isolated venv; versions recorded per passport with exact PyPI artifact digests. Motivated by SEC-01.
